baseline.method: Original author g2o canonical SE2 Gauss-Newton 20 iterations, Eigen sparse LDLT

metric_definitions.position_max_error_m: maximum node Euclidean position distance to method reference; fixed identity anchor, no alignment
metric_definitions.heading_max_error_rad: maximum absolute wrapped angular difference to method reference
metric_definitions.weighted_observation_error: sum all 1483 canonical residual transpose information residual

provenance: Frozen before local extraction; original GN20/GN50 position discrepancy 5.372117310351247e-10 m and angle 1.4486190025309043e-12 rad. Numerical tolerances are conservative backend allowances, not physical GT errors.
